description: Any app, agent or model server instrumented with the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions and sent to Prometheus (OTLP receiver or exporter, default name translation): client operations, tokens, server latency (TTFT, time per output token), agent invocations, tool executions and MCP operations. Percentiles are computed per job, because each instrumentation picks its own histogram buckets.

panels.title: Client operations/s
panels.description: GenAI client operations (chat, embeddings, generate_content...) recorded by instrumented apps.

panels.title: Client error ratio
panels.description: Operations recorded with error.type.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Client p95
panels.description: 95th percentile client operation duration.

panels.title: Tokens/s
panels.description: Input + output tokens per second (gen_ai.client.token.usage).

panels.title: Server TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first token reported by model servers.

panels.title: Agent invocations/s
panels.description: Agent invocations (gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration), e.g. kagent agents.

panels.title: Operations by model
panels.description: Operations per requested model and operation.

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: Failed operations by model and error.type (timeout, 429, 500, exception class).

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, error_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Operation duration
panels.description: Client-side duration including network and queueing at the provider.

panels.title: Operation duration p95 by model
panels.description: Latency per requested model.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tokens by type
panels.description: Input and output tokens per second.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Tokens per second per model and direction.

panels.title: Tokens per operation (p95)
panels.description: Prompt and completion size distribution.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_bucket{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Token counters (newer conventions)
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.* counters from the semantic-conventions-genai repo (kagent harness runtimes emit them). Empty if your instrumentation still uses gen_ai.client.token.usage.

panels.title: Server request duration
panels.description: Time to last byte or last output token on the model server or gateway.

panels.title: Server time to first token
panels.description: Prefill plus queueing.

panels.title: Time per output token p95 by model
panels.description: Decode speed per model.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_server_time_per_output_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", gen_ai_provider_name=~"$provider", gen_ai_request_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Server requests by model
panels.description: Requests served per model.

panels.title: Agent invocation p95 by agent
panels.description: Duration of one agent invocation (turn).

panels.title: Agent invocations by agent
panels.description: Invocations and failed invocations per agent.

panels.title: Tool execution p95 by tool
panels.description: gen_ai.execute_tool.duration per tool.

panels.title: Model and tool calls per invocation (p95)
panels.description: How many model and tool calls an agent makes per invocation. Rising numbers mean loops or harder tasks.

panels.title: MCP operation p95 by method
panels.description: mcp.client.operation.duration and mcp.server.operation.duration (OpenTelemetry MCP conventions).

panels.title: MCP operations by method
panels.description: MCP operations per method on the client and server side.

title: LLM / GenAI (OpenTelemetry)
